create_dataloader: create a DataLoader with optional class-balanced or checkpointable sampling for a PyTorch dataset
create_dataset_images: create an ImageFolder or CocoStuff dataset with transforms from a folder of images
create_dataset_hdf5: create an HDF5-based dataset with optional instance features and nearest neighbor conditioning
create_class_balanced_weights: create sampling weights for class-balanced data loading using standard or temperature-controlled distribution
create_distribution_sampler: create a Distribution tensor for noise or label sampling with normal, categorical, or long-tail distributions
